name: fl-local-codes
title: Florida Local Codes of Ordinances: Publication and Currency, 2026
description: Where each of Florida's 478 local governments publishes its code of ordinances, who publishes it, and how current that code is. One row per county and per incorporated municipality, covering all 67 counties and all 411 cities, towns and villages. Municipal law is the hardest layer of American law to locate: there is no master index, and each commercial codifier lists only its own clients, so a reader who does not already know who publishes a town's code has nowhere to start. This dataset is that missing index for one state, and it records the jurisdictions no codifier carries, which is the part no vendor list can show. Currency is measured from the codifier's own stated codification date, so a code that has not been supplemented in years is visible as such.

sources.title: US Census Bureau subcounty population estimates, vintage 2024
Municode public client and content API
American Legal Publishing Florida code library

fields.name: geoid
fields.description: Census GEOID: 12 followed by the county FIPS code, or 12 followed by the place FIPS code

fields.name: name
fields.description: jurisdiction name without its type suffix

fields.name: type
fields.description: county | city | town | village, taken from the Census, never from the codifier

fields.name: county
fields.description: the county the jurisdiction sits in; for a county row, itself

fields.name: counties
fields.description: every county the place falls in, pipe separated, largest population share first

fields.name: population
fields.description: Census population estimate, vintage 2024

fields.name: code_status
fields.description: online-html | online-pdf-only | no-online-code | unknown

fields.name: publisher
fields.description: municode | american-legal | general-code | code-publishing | self-hosted | none | unknown

fields.name: code_url
fields.description: the verified URL of the code of ordinances; empty where no code is online

fields.name: publisher_client_id
fields.description: the codifier's own identifier for this jurisdiction, where it has one

fields.name: code_product_id
fields.description: Municode product id for the code of ordinances; the key to its table of contents

fields.name: codified_through
fields.description: date of the most recent ordinance included in the code, as the publisher states it

fields.name: code_last_updated
fields.description: date the publisher last posted an update online

fields.name: pdf_available
fields.description: 1 where the publisher offers the code as a downloadable PDF

fields.name: pending_ordinances_count
fields.description: adopted ordinances awaiting codification, per the publisher; null outside Municode

fields.name: official_status
fields.description: official | unofficial | unstated -- recorded only where the page says so, never inferred

fields.name: source
fields.description: municode-api | browser | manual -- how this row was resolved

fields.name: source_checked_date
fields.description: the date this row was checked; codifier contracts move, so the date is part of the claim

fields.name: notes
fields.description: free text, used mainly for jurisdictions no codifier carries

fields.name: statement
fields.description: the row written as one self-contained English sentence, so it can be retrieved, quoted and checked on its own
